verdict.rationale: Viam documents generic ML tooling that could carry such a model: bring-your-own-model support with local on-machine inference and versioned rollout, plus logic modules that read a camera and command an arm. Nothing in the evidence mentions vision-language-action or robotics foundation models, so this integration would rest on generic model deployment and custom module code. Missing for 10: explicit VLA/foundation-model support or integrations, documented workflow for wiring policy outputs into motion/control, examples or hands-on corroboration.
